findings.title: Terminal reason projection has no hard depth/size bound
findings.evidence: Each allowed wrapper recursively calls terminal_reason/1 without reducing a depth budget; any finite nested shutdown/handshake/tls_alert chain is fully retained and inspect(limit:infinity) writes the full chain. Integer reasons are also retained without a representation bound. Public metadata.error/reason type is arbitrary term. Thus callback/log projection is not bounded independently of the input, contrary to the assigned bounded safe projection contract. No runtime trigger is claimed.
findings.required_repair: Use a small explicit depth budget and fixed omitted marker at exhaustion; allow only bounded scalar values (e.g. literal safe atom allowlist, and omit or bound integer values). Do not stringify/hash/inspect unknown raw reasons or include full state. Keep callback send-only and all assertions unchanged.

findings.title: Missing error key and explicit nil are indistinguishable
findings.evidence: metadata[:error] returns nil for both absent key and explicit error:nil; safe_metadata always inserts error field. New error:nil log cannot prove original error absence. Even proven error absence would still conflate local_closed/peer_closed/shutdown in TI.
findings.recommended_repair: Add error_present=Map.has_key?(metadata,:error), and optionally reason_present/kind_present. In all cases retain UNKNOWN causal interpretation; do not replace monitor or terminal assertions.
